title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression adds a penalty to the loss function to prevent overfitting. This penalty is controlled by the hyperparameter lambda. Can you think about how increasing lambda might affect the model's complexity?

title: Effect of Lambda on Training Error
text: When you increase lambda, the model becomes less flexible. Consider how this might impact the model's ability to fit the training data closely.

title: Training Error and Lambda
text: As lambda increases, what happens to the training error?
